card.name: Linking words before drug effect statements
card.fires_on: Small linking words (are, to, be, lower, form) right after a drug name or clause, where the sentence is about to describe what the drug does, such as placental transfer or antagonism.

modes.label: Verb after drug subject
modes.description: A verb such as are or form follows a drug class or compound and introduces its effect.
modes.example: Results of animal studies indicate that tetracyclines cross the placenta,<< are>> found in fetal tissues, and can have

modes.label: Link before a cause or result
modes.description: The words to, be or lower come after phrases like due, shown to, or leading to and precede a mechanism or outcome.
modes.example: Chloramphenicol has been shown to<< be>> antagonistic to beta-lactam antib
